title: Podcast about Sketching Irish Music
content: If you like sketching Irish traditional music,this podcastis for you. Boston-based musician Shannon Heaton talks toBrian Vallely,Vincent Crotty,Catharine Kingcome, andme. Topics covered include about traveling pipers, a dilapidated hotel in the Hudson Valley, Dudley Street dance hall in post WWII America, and a country home in County Clare.----Trad on Canvasby Shannon Heaton
